fast.$description: A state that changes under the pointer: hover, focus, pressed.

base.$description: The default: a colour or a border settling after a state change.

slow.$description: A movement the eye is meant to follow, like a thumb crossing its track.

standard.$description: Leaves immediately and settles: what most state changes use.

decelerate.$description: An element entering the screen, arriving without overshoot.

accelerate.$description: An element leaving the screen: it starts slow and is gone.

linear.$description: Motion with no easing, for something that must not appear to settle.

transition.$description: The only timing a component reads: duration and easing together, so one rule retimes the kit and reduced motion can replace it with a duration alone.
